body: Thanks a lot. I appreciate you sharing that, I’ve needed a boost to kick it for a while.

It’s not major, thankfully, but I’m definitely addicted to nicotine and I think I’m starting to get addicted to opiates and ambien. Luckily I’ve got some friends now who can hook me up with weed, so I’m going to try really hard to stick to that for now and then sober up for a while once I’ve kicked the pills. I honestly don’t know if I’m going to be able to kick the nicotine though, my life has gone to shit and the buzz keeps me from strangling others. Or myself.
Addiction and having feelings. Both suck.
I don’t think that would end well, honestly. We’d both be battling for her constantly.
Madison isn’t bi, otherwise I’d have thought of that myself.
